headline: NYY @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.12 at BAL 3.27, with a projected total of 7.39. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: NYY moved -2.72 runs while BAL moved -0.51, changing the projected margin by -2.21 runs. The projected total fell -3.23, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +18.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Max Fried has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Samuel Basallo, Aaron Judge, Paul Goldschmidt, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Coby Mayo, Taylor Ward because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
